🎬 Time Bandits (2024)
​Time Bandits is a fantasy adventure comedy series created by the heavy-hitting comedic trio of Taika Waititi, Jemaine Clement, and Iain Morris. Serving as a modern reimagining of Terry Gilliam’s beloved 1981 cult classic film, the show introduces viewers to Kevin (Kal-El Tuck), an 11-year-old history buff whose passion for the ancient world isolates him from his tech-obsessed parents. Kevin’s mundane life gets flipped upside down when a portal suddenly tears open inside his bedroom wardrobe, throwing him into the company of an eccentric, ragtag group of dimension-hopping thieves.

​Led by the deeply confident yet wonderfully inept Penelope (Lisa Kudrow), this band of outlaws has stolen a mystical map belonging to the Supreme Being, allowing them to travel through space and time to plunder historical treasures. As Kevin reluctantly joins their ranks, he serves as the much-needed historical guide for the clueless group as they escape through various portals. Their episodic escapades take them from the construction of Stonehenge and the fall of Troy to Prohibition-era Harlem and ice-age tundras. However, the stakes quickly escalate into a grand quest to save Kevin’s parents and the entire universe when the malicious entity known as "Pure Evil" (Jemaine Clement) seeks to hunt them down and seize the map for himself.

​Visually ambitious, the show blended nearly 5,000 computer-generated visual effects shots with practical animatronics, creature suits, and miniatures to bring its vast historical epochs to life. Tone-wise, the 2024 adaptation traded the cynical, dark, Python-esque nihilism of the original 1981 film for a gentler, more lighthearted brand of family-friendly absurdity. While critics and audiences generally praised the series for its charming performances and witty humor, the show struggled to secure a massive global viewership, leading to its cancellation by Apple TV+ after just one season in September 2024.

Trinity drags in like a lazy drifter, plants himself in front of the pan, and shovels beans straight from the skillet as if the whole gunfight-hungry frontier can wait, and it does. Every other Western hero is all squint and menace, while Terence Hill plays it with a lazy grin and a sleepy calm that make the tough guys look like they're trying too hard. Hill and Bud Spencer became one of cinema's great duos here, and the film was a massive hit in Italy that spawned a sequel and a whole wave of comedy Westerns. It all unfolds across a dusty frontier where the joke is that nothing is worth rushing for except dinner. The West was wild, but Trinity was hungry.

​This mini series is actually a follow-up to the hilarious 2022 Netflix comedy Man vs Bee? The series brings back the legendary comedian Rowan Atkinson as Trevor Bingley, a man whose attempts to enjoy a peaceful life somehow turn into absolute chaos!

​Here's the interesting part: Rowan Atkinson didn't just star in the series; he also co-created and co-wrote it with Will Davies. The show reunites the creative team behind Man vs Bee, including director David Kerr.
 
​Unlike a traditional action-packed comedy, Man vs Baby relies heavily on physical humour, awkward situations, and Trevor's increasingly ridiculous attempts to keep everything under control. With only four episodes, it's a short, entertaining Christmas comedy packed with unexpected disasters.

The Bajdida wedding tragedy, also known as the Al-Hamdaniya fire, was a disaster that occurred on the night of September 26, 2023, at an event hall in the Iraqi city of Bajdida, in Nineveh Governorate. The fire claimed the lives of 114 people and left more than 150 injured during the celebration of a Christian wedding attended by nearly 1,000 guests.

 The fire broke out during the couple's main dance when pyrotechnic devices were ignited inside the venue. The sparks quickly reached the ceiling, which was covered with flammable polystyrene panels and highly combustible synthetic materials, prohibited under local building regulations due to their extreme danger. Within just a few minutes, the ceiling structure gave way and collapsed onto the crowd, while also releasing toxic gases such as hydrogen cyanide and carbon monoxide from the burning plastics. The rapid spread of the flames, lack of adequate emergency exits, absence of fire-extinguishing systems, and power outage turned the venue into a deadly trap, making evacuation and rescue efforts extremely difficult. Subsequent official investigations determined that the main cause of the disaster was serious negligence on the part of the event hall's owners and the local authorities responsible for overseeing licenses.

 The Iraqi government declared three days of national mourning, arrested the owners of the venue, and launched rigorous inspections across the country to shut down public spaces that failed to meet minimum fire-safety standards. The tragic incident had a profound impact on the Assyrian and Christian community of the Nineveh Plains, a population that had already been deeply affected by years of armed conflict, persecution, and forced displacement due to the presence of the Islamic State in the region.
